items.name: Pheru
items.about: Insaan, Circulyst ka pickup partner. Launch ke baad kahani mein solution wahi lekar aata hai: sahi rate, digital kaanta, receipt. 3D wala naya version abhi aana baaki hai.
lines: Pehle rate, phir kaanta, phir receipt.

items.name: Raddi Raja
items.about: Mohalle ka raddi ka raja (adult): akhbaar ka taaj, Kanpuriya moonchh, hara gamcha, akhbaar print wali shirt, peeth pe jute ki bori, haath mein bandha hua gatta-raddi. Har shehar mein same; local bolchaal aur ek local cheez badalti hai.
lines: Kachre mein phenkoge? Bhaukaal mat maaro!

items.name: Botal Bhaiya
items.about: Transparent PET bottle, ulti hari topi, kaala chashma, khaali hari label, backpack. Cool aur tez bolne wala. Plastic ko dho ke, sukha ke, alag rakhna sikhata hai.
lines: Ek baar use, phir bekaar? Na bhai, hum toh recycle hote hain.
Dho do, sukha do, thaile mein daal do. Simple.

items.name: Tinku Tin
items.about: Steel ka dabba, dent wala, laal-safed sweatband, bicep dikhata hai, laal joote. Metal baar-baar recycle hota hai, yahi uska bhaukaal hai.
lines: Ek dent se kuch nahi hota, hum toh baar-baar bante hain.

items.name: Mobile Mama
items.about: Purana keypad phone, crack wali screen hi chehra, gol sunehra chashma, jhola. Bhulakkad par samajhdaar. Safety wali baatein yahi batata hai.
lines: E-waste kachre mein? Na baba na.

items.name: Dumpasur
items.about: Jute ki bhari bori ka daanav, upar se gatta, bottle aur tin bahar nikal rahe hain. Jab sab kabaad ek bore mein bhar dete ho, ye bada hota hai. Kamzori: 3 thaile. Kabhi jalana nahi: 'Dumpasur Vadh', 'Dahan' nahi.
lines: Sab mila do, sab mujhe de do!

v2.status: Final 3D (26 Oct): har character ka 1 pose
v2.style: 3D animated-film look, saari Gang ek hi style mein. Reels mein ab yahi PNGs (transparent) use hongi. Abhi har character ka sirf 1 pose hai; aur poses/expressions aayenge to yahin judenge.
v2.deliverables: Baad mein (zaroori nahi): har character ke 2-3 aur poses ya expressions, alag PNG, transparent, 1080px+. Pheru ka 3D version.
